verses.original: לְכוּ֙ וְנָשׁ֣וּבָה אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י ה֥וּא טָרָ֖ף וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑נוּ יַ֖ךְ וְיַחְבְּשֵֽׁנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū wə·nā·šū·ḇāh ’el- Yah·weh kî hū ṭā·rāp̄ wə·yir·pā·’ê·nū yaḵ wə·yaḥ·bə·šê·nū
verses.literal: Come let us return to the LORD For He has torn us to pieces but He will heal us He has wounded us but He will bind up our wounds
verses.literalPt: Vinde, e voltemos para Jeová, porque ele despedaçou e nos sarará; feriu e nos atará a ferida.

verses.original: יְחַיֵּ֖נוּ מִיֹּמָ֑יִם בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקִמֵ֖נוּ וְנִחְיֶ֥ה לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḥay·yê·nū mî·yō·mā·yim bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî yə·qi·mê·nū wə·niḥ·yeh lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: After two days He will revive us on the third day He will raise us up that we may live in His presence
verses.literalPt: Depois de dois dias, nos revigorará; ao terceiro dia, nos levantará, e viveremos diante dele.

verses.original: וְנֵדְעָ֣ה נִרְדְּפָ֗ה לָדַ֙עַת֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כְּשַׁ֖חַר נָכ֣וֹן מֽוֹצָא֑וֹ וְיָב֤וֹא כַגֶּ֙שֶׁם֙ לָ֔נוּ כְּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ י֥וֹרֶה אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nê·ḏə·‘āh nir·də·p̄āh lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ’eṯ- Yah·weh kə·ša·ḥar nā·ḵō·wn mō·w·ṣā·’ōw wə·yā·ḇō·w ḵag·ge·šem lā·nū kə·mal·qō·wōš yō·w·reh ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: So let us know let us press on to know the LORD As surely as the sun rises He will appear He will come to us like the rain like the spring showers that water the earth
verses.literalPt: Conheçamos, prossigamos em conhecer a Jeová; a sua saída é certa como a alva; e ele descerá sobre nós como a chuva, como a chuva serôdia que rega a terra.

verses.original: מָ֤ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂה־ לְּךָ֖ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְחַסְדְּכֶם֙ כַּֽעֲנַן־ בֹּ֔קֶר וְכַטַּ֖ל מַשְׁכִּ֥ים הֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lə·ḵā ’ep̄·ra·yim māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lə·ḵā yə·hū·ḏāh wə·ḥas·də·ḵem ka·‘ă·nan- bō·qer wə·ḵaṭ·ṭal maš·kîm hō·lêḵ
verses.literal: What shall I do with you O Ephraim What shall I do with you O Judah For your loyalty is like a morning mist like the early dew that vanishes
verses.literalPt: Que te farei, ó Efraim? Que te farei, ó Judá? Porque a vossa bondade é como a nuvem da manhã e como o orvalho que cedo passa.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן חָצַ֙בְתִּי֙ בַּנְּבִיאִ֔ים הֲרַגְתִּ֖ים בְּאִמְרֵי־ פִ֑י וּמִשְׁפָּטֶ֖יךָ א֥וֹר יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ḥā·ṣaḇ·tî ban·nə·ḇî·’îm hă·raḡ·tîm bə·’im·rê- p̄î ū·miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā ’ō·wr yê·ṣê
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I have hewn them by the prophets I have slain them by the words of My mouth and My judgments go forth like lightning
verses.literalPt: Por isso, os cortei pelos profetas; pelas palavras da minha boca, os matei; e os juízos a teu respeito são como a luz que sai.

verses.original: כִּ֛י חֶ֥סֶד חָפַ֖צְתִּי וְלֹא־ זָ֑בַח וְדַ֥עַת אֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵעֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥe·seḏ ḥā·p̄aṣ·tî wə·lō- zā·ḇaḥ wə·ḏa·‘aṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm mê·‘ō·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: For I desire mercy not sacrifice and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings
verses.literalPt: Pois misericórdia quero e não sacrifício; e o conhecimento de Deus, mais do que holocaustos.

verses.original: וְהֵ֕מָּה כְּאָדָ֖ם עָבְר֣וּ בְרִ֑ית שָׁ֖ם בָּ֥גְדוּ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm·māh kə·’ā·ḏām ‘ā·ḇə·rū ḇə·rîṯ šām bā·ḡə·ḏū ḇî
verses.literal: But they like Adam have transgressed the covenant there they were unfaithful to Me
verses.literalPt: Porém eles, como Adão, transgrediram a aliança; ali, se houveram aleivosamente contra mim.

verses.original: גִּלְעָ֕ד קִרְיַ֖ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן עֲקֻבָּ֖ה מִדָּֽם׃
verses.literal: Gilead is a city of evildoers . . . tracked with footprints of blood
verses.literalPt: Gileade é uma cidade dos que obram iniquidade, é manchada de sangue.

verses.original: וּכְחַכֵּ֨י אִ֜ישׁ גְּדוּדִ֗ים חֶ֚בֶר כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים דֶּ֖רֶךְ יְרַצְּחוּ־ שֶׁ֑כְמָה כִּ֥י זִמָּ֖ה עָשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḥak·kê ’îš gə·ḏū·ḏîm ḥe·ḇer kō·hă·nîm de·reḵ yə·raṣ·ṣə·ḥū- šeḵ·māh kî zim·māh ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: Like raiders who lie in ambush . . . so does a band of priests they murder on the way to Shechem surely they have committed atrocities
verses.literalPt: Como tropas de salteadores espreitam um homem, assim a companhia dos sacerdotes mata no caminho de Siquém; cometem a vilania.

verses.original: בְּבֵית֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רָאִ֖יתִי שַׁעֲרִירִיָּה שָׁ֚ם זְנ֣וּת לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם נִטְמָ֖א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl rā·’î·ṯî ša·ʿă·rī·rī·yå̄h šām zə·nūṯ lə·’ep̄·ra·yim niṭ·mā yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing Ephraim practices prostitution there and Israel is defiled
verses.literalPt: Na casa de Israel, vi uma coisa horrenda: ali se acha a fornicação em Efraim, e Israel está contaminado.

verses.original: גַּם־ יְהוּדָ֕ה שָׁ֥ת קָצִ֖יר לָ֑ךְ בְּשׁוּבִ֖י שְׁב֥וּת עַמִּֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: gam- yə·hū·ḏāh šāṯ qā·ṣîr lāḵ bə·šū·ḇî šə·ḇūṯ ‘am·mî
verses.literal: Also for you O Judah a harvest is appointed when I restore My people from captivity
verses.literalPt: Também para ti, ó Judá, está assinada uma ceifa, quando eu tornar a trazer o cativeiro do meu povo.
